Population increased in Chesterfield

The estimated population of Chesterfield in 2024 was 106,045 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that Chesterfield's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Chesterfield increased by 2.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Chesterfield was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Chesterfield

The average (median) age stayed at 44.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Chesterfield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Chesterfield is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Chesterfield's population of 106,045 usual residents was made up of:

  • 17,604 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.6%)
  • 64,755 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.1%)
  • 23,686 people aged 65 years and over, (22.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Chesterfield has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Chesterfield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Chesterfield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Chesterfield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 389 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 894 births and 1,283 deaths in Chesterfield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 575 (0.5%). There were 5,658 people entering the area and 5,083 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Chesterfield's population of 531 (0.5%) as a result of 639 people entering the area and 108 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Chesterfield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Chesterfield in mid-2023 is 105,325.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 185 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 257 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 442 people.
